content: Machine translation has made remarkable progress, and studies claiming it to reach a human parity are starting to appear BIBREF0. However, when evaluating translations of the whole documents rather than isolated sentences, human raters show a stronger preference for human over machine translation BIBREF1. These findings emphasize the need to shift towards context-aware machine translation both from modeling and evaluation perspective.
